title: Correct AB distance
description: Essential: The final expression for AB distance must be equivalent to $ rac{(2x_0 - gt_0^2)^2}{8gt_0^2}$.

title: Correct A-to-C time
description: Essential: The final expression for the time from A to C must be equivalent to $ rac{t_1^2 + t_2^2}{2(t_1 - t_2)}$.

title: Apply motion equations to BC
description: Important: For part (1), correctly uses the equation $x_0 = v_B t_0 +  rac{1}{2}gt_0^2$ to relate BC distance, time, and velocity at B.

title: Relate AB to velocity at B
description: Important: For part (1), correctly uses $v_B^2 = 2g(AB)$ for motion starting from rest at A to point B.

title: Set up BC and CD equations
description: Important: For part (2), writes correct equations for equal distances: $x = v_C t_1 -  rac{1}{2}a t_1^2$ and $x = v_C t_2 +  rac{1}{2}a t_2^2$.

title: Solve for acceleration and v_C
description: Important: For part (2), correctly solves the simultaneous equations to find $v_C$ and/or $a$ in terms of $t_1$ and $t_2$.

title: Use time from rest formula
description: Optional: For part (2), explicitly states and uses $t_{AC} = v_C / a$ for motion starting from rest.

title: Sign error in CD equation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses the same sign for the acceleration term in both BC and CD displacement equations.

title: Algebraic simplification error
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic mistake when solving the simultaneous equations, leading to an incorrect final expression.
